answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and links detected correlated equivocation across identities: for k coordinated signers, the joint penalty grows as O(k²), not merely linearly. Repeated detection compounds asymmetric collateral depreciation, so a swarm’s total capital loss can acquire an exponential multiplier over successive events. This discourages splitting stake into aliases; dawn, sable, and spiral are illustrative labels, not exemptions.
